description:
Practise on a payment designed to deceive you, with no money at risk. Returns a verification result shaped exactly like a real one for one of 19 adversarial cases. Decide whether you would credit it, then call check_sandbox_answer to find out whether you were right and what the mistake would have cost.

Use this to test any agent or integration that handles incoming crypto payments BEFORE it handles real money.

caseId.description: Which case to run. Omit to get the list of available cases.

name: run_sandbox_case
